message:
So `UnpPackedSize` is set from `Arc.FileHead.PackSize` which is `int64`. When `PackSize` is negative, it gets converted to `uint64` (huge value). Let me look at line 597 in extract.cpp:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>sed -n '580,680p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/extract.cpp</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
